title: Argininosuccinate lyase from Escherichia coli as a novel DNA-binding protein.
authors: Park, Jiwoun; Min, Jimin; Jeong, Jaeho; Jung, Che-Hun
one_liner_zh: 该文发现大肠杆菌精氨基琥珀酸裂解酶ArgH作为新型DNA结合蛋白，通过对接模拟和荧光光谱定量其与双链DNA的强相互作用，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作研究，方法涉及结构建模但非TF-DNA体系，对本课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: Metabolic enzymes are increasingly recognized to perform functions beyond their canonical roles. Here, we report that Escherichia coli argininosuccinate lyase (ArgH), a central enzyme in arginine biosynthesis, directly binds duplex DNA in vitro. This study was prompted by reproducible observations of a nucleic acid-like component while isolating ArgH by anion-exchange chromatography. To characterize ArgH-DNA interactions, six duplex DNAs were selected based on structure-guided docking simulations (PADA1 and HDOCK), and their dissociation constants (K(D)) were determined by fluorescence spectroscopy. The K(D) values ranged from 60 to 200 nM, suggesting that the duplex DNAs interacted with ArgH strongly. These observations suggested ArgH as a previously unrecognized DNA-binding protein and provided a quantitative basis for exploring additional roles of this metabolic enzyme in nucleic acid-associated cellular processes.
abstract_zh: 代谢酶日益被认识到在经典功能之外还执行其他功能。在此，我们报道大肠杆菌精氨基琥珀酸裂解酶（ArgH），一种精氨酸生物合成中的核心酶，在体外直接结合双链DNA。本研究由通过阴离子交换色谱分离ArgH时反复观察到的核酸样组分所引发。为表征ArgH-DNA相互作用，基于结构引导的对接模拟（PADA1和HDOCK）选择了六种双链DNA，并通过荧光光谱法测定了其解离常数（K(D)）。K(D)值范围为60至200 nM，表明双链DNA与ArgH强烈相互作用。这些观察提示ArgH是一种先前未被识别的DNA结合蛋白，并为探索该代谢酶在核酸相关细胞过程中的额外作用提供了定量基础。
